title: Pod Salt Core Havana Gold Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Havana Gold is Pod Salt’s attempt at capturing the rich, deep and satisfying flavour of a real cigar, and we have to say that it’s spot on with its robust yet smooth draw and authentic flavour. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
